name: Animal Auditory
body:
School divination; Level druid 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (appropriate animal, not consumed during casting)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

By holding your ears and concentrating, you can hear through the ears of an animal (companion or other) that regards you as friendly or helpful. The animal must willingly agree with your request. The animal acts as a scout or spy, allowing you to hear exactly what the animal hears or interprets (in the case of bats or dolphins). Of course, the animal does not always follow exact requests and may be distracted by instinct, hunger or other factors. Unfortunately, your mind is not able to interpret sounds that you would not normally be able to hear.

This means one cannot use a bat’s sonar to map a dark cave or locate enemies in darkness.
